text: {"lessons":["After investing in several stocks, I should set position-size limits so no single holding or sector can put too much of my apartment savings at risk.","My account fell for several months while I made no trades; I should review whether my reasons for holding still hold and rebalance by plan, rather than either ignoring a sustained decline or reacting to every dip.","I should keep a cash reserve and invest gradually, so I can handle uncertainty and avoid committing too much at once."]}
